contract: Frozen: ARCHITECTURE.md, src/core/ports.ts. Need a change: factory signal, take the reversible default. Read concepts/live-realtime.md sections 3, 4, 5, 7, 10. Layers: channel L1 (react only), live L2 (./data), views L4 prop-fed (no Query in ./page). Read docs/v3/spikes/live-poller.md first (P1): if per-observer cost is at most 1 extra fetch, build liveQuery with function-form refetchInterval and no poller; otherwise build the central poller (about 80 lines).
change: liveQuery(options, freshness) setting staleTime, focus flags, meta.basalt.live, refetchInterval false. Freshness 'static' maps to staleTime Infinity, never the string 'static' (4.6), 'standard' (refetch on focus when stale, 30 s), ticker {every (number or q => number|false), pauseWhileMutating?, background?, external?}, pushed {fallback, safety}. A function every returning false gives 30 s, not 0. Poller skips a tick when hidden (unless background), offline, mutating, errored 401 or 403, or in flight; counts enabled observers only; the least active class wins and dev warns; refetch cancelRefetch false. Dev asserts on a bare QueryClient and staleTime overrides (literal NODE_ENV). Rule: none (live-5 owns the clauses). Skill: generated docs/live-query.md. Tests: P1, P1b, P3, P5.
